# porch_role (Resource)

A custom role of a tenant: a set of permissions (`<resource_type>:<action>`, either side may be `*`) plus the roles it bundles. Needs `role:manage`; delegated administrators may only define roles with permissions they hold (`403 privilege_escalation` otherwise). Updates replace the definition (PUT). Import with `<tenant>/<role_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_role" "media_viewer" {
  tenant      = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  slug        = "media-viewer"
  name        = "Media viewer"
  permissions = ["app:access", "media:read"]
}

resource "porch_role" "media_admin" {
  tenant      = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  slug        = "media-admin"
  name        = "Media admin"
  permissions = ["media:*"]
  includes    = [porch_role.media_viewer.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Identifier, unique in the tenant (`admin` and `member` are built in). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `includes` (Set of String) IDs of roles bundled into this one (a DAG of depth ≤ 5).
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions granted, e.g. `app:access`, `media:read`, `app:*`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role ID (`rol_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_role.media_viewer <tenant>/<role_id>
```
